visual.general_description: Nine-panel figure labelled A to I: three clinical photographs, three MRI-type images and three endoscopic images of venous malformations.
visual.detailed_description: Three rows of three panels. Row one (A to C) holds close-up color photographs, two of skin with faint bluish marks and one of a protruded tongue with a blue-grey patch, each with a white arrow. Row two (D to F) holds grayscale MRI-type images on black backgrounds: a cropped low-contrast image (D), an axial pelvic section with two arrows (E), and a coronal pelvic and thigh section with one arrow (F). Row three (G to I) holds round endoscopic images: a red-dotted pale mucosal surface (G), a protruding pale lobulated mass with an arrow (H) and a small reddish lesion with an arrow (I). Panel letters are printed in white at the upper left of each panel. No scale bars or other printed text.

Lower left shows metal clamps holding a dark red-brown nodular lesion at an incision. Lower right shows an excised or lifted dark red round lesion held by an instrument over pale bowel loops.
